In its 20 years, the @GlobalFund partnership has saved 44 million lives – providing life-saving treatment to children & changing the story of global health.

Today, we celebrate its 20th anniversary and recognize the impact of U.S. leadership in fighting #AIDS, #TB and #Malaria. https://t.co/kfytIw6vzS

Today is #WorldCancerDay, and as a result of this disease, millions of patients and survivors acquire life-long lymphedema as a result of their treatment.

Pleased to cosponsor the #LymphedemaTreatmentAct to support those in their battle against cancer.

Athletes risk punishment from the Chinese government and the I.O.C. if they exercise free speech.
 
#Beijing2022
https://t.co/4LiM4m45VG

Kansans will have the opportunity to receive the best care and cancer treatment in the country. 

Kansans will also have the opportunity to change the world right here at home, and one day, God willing, find a cure for cancer.

“Moran and leaders at the health system framed the project as a key step toward making KU an international leader in cancer care and treatment in years to come.”

More from @KCStar >> https://t.co/dqQjkYd1j3

Access to outpatient and emergency services are vital for rural community survival. I introduced the Rural Hospital Adjustment Act to help rural hospitals continue to care for individuals in their communities. https://t.co/TXX7RK0D7P

It should not be difficult for veterans to use both their earned VA health benefits and Medicare.

@SenAngusKing and I introduced legislation to help veterans, as well as their caregivers and providers, better coordinate care between these two government health systems. https://t.co/wQt7qWCkZn

Great to be at the Coffeyville Regional Medical Center to break ground for their new primary care clinic.

The clinic will provide room for more patients and create room for more job opportunities in the area. https://t.co/GH7vvRvJ49

The Gaza pier was a failure that cost taxpayers millions of dollars and put our troops at risk. Congress must exercise its constitutional responsibilities any time our Armed Forces are placed in danger. https://t.co/0A98XUNqMc

Yesterday, I toured Cheyenne County Hospital in St. Francis and met with CEO Jeremy Clingenpeel. On our tour, we discussed the importance of 340B and challenges rural hospitals face.

Thanks to all those who joined us on the tour and for taking the time to meet with me. https://t.co/pSYkOfJIfC

The 2024 General Election is tomorrow! I encourage all eligible voters across Kansas to exercise their Constitutional right to vote.

Visit https://t.co/J8siJPCh4S to find where you can cast your vote on Election Day. https://t.co/0yVpHY06VW

Named after an honorary Kansan and advocate for veterans, the Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare & Benefits Improvement Act will better support veterans, caregivers and survivors.

Read more about this legislation ⬇️
https://t.co/M2tL2D7aPC

After months of working with veterans, caregivers, VSOs and others, I am pleased to see the President sign the Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare & Benefits Improvement Act into law to best support our nation’s veterans. https://t.co/3uwcUbqKnG

Millions of veterans in America are dually enrolled in VA health care and Medicare.

Helping these veterans, their caregivers and providers navigate these two systems will help eliminate gaps in care, improve outcomes and lower expenses for taxpayers. https://t.co/k72WljMRWp

Researching how low-level blast injuries are impacting veteran mental health will help make certain VA  provides veterans with an accurate diagnosis and treatment plan.

Learn more about my legislation with @SenAngusKing: https://t.co/N9Se6ZbLcS

Many rural hospitals in KS rely on the 340B program to serve their communities & keep their doors open. 
I serve on the Senate 340B Working Group, which is drafting legislation to help sustain this critical program.

https://t.co/eVmwVLAHeV

The Veterans ACCESS Act would increase access to care for veterans by, among other things, codifying MISSION Act access standards and making certain they include mental health residential rehabilitation treatment programs. The bill would also require VA to take veteran preference and continuity of care into account when determining whether it is in a veteran’s best medical interest to refer a veteran to a community provider.

Today, I participated in the groundbreaking for the new Pittsburg wastewater treatment plant, a project that was made possible through local, state and federal resources. Thanks to everyone who attended and contributed to this project, including City Manager Daron Hall, Mayor Dawn McNay, Public Utilities Director Matt Bacon and Craig VanWey with KS Dept. of Commerce.

Happy #NationalNursesWeek to the nurses across Kansas who are keeping our communities safe and healthy. Thank you for going above and beyond to provide compassionate, quality care to your patients. https://t.co/b0xqmyyfCV

GOOD NEWS: The @DeptVetAffairs is implementing my bill - the Sen. Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare & Benefits Improvement Act - to make certain veterans receive the care that is in their best medical interest.

https://t.co/ZB7XviK5DM

On Friday we broke ground on the new @KUcancercenter in Kansas City, KS! I helped secure federal resources to build & equip this center, which will conduct life-saving research and treatment to end cancer & help solidify Kansas as a global leader in cancer care & research. https://t.co/ul9s2YCejs

Kansas will be well represented with KS State Rep. Patrick Penn as the @USDA Deputy Secretary for Food, Nutrition and Consumer Services. I look forward to working with Mr. Penn to boost food security & support American farmers.

Visited hospitals in Goodland, Ness City and Scott City last week to learn more about their work in rural communities and ways they are expanding access to health care for Kansans. Thank you to the doctors, nurses and hospital leadership for working to keep Kansans healthy. https://t.co/IKCuxiOkaM

Enjoyed meeting with @kansasrealtors during their visit to D.C. We discussed the importance of flood and natural disaster insurance for KS homeowners & red tape that makes it difficult to buy or sell homes. I appreciate KAR's advocacy for KS homeowners & their members. https://t.co/2vtYXKwyuq

This weekend I visited Sabetha Community Hospital & Amberwell Atchison to tour their facilities & learn more about their work to serve patients. These hospitals are essential to their communities, and I thank them for their commitment to providing Kansans with the care they need. https://t.co/uKfuGeHuJD
